22711.upd: Oil rigs are now the only places to extract fuel in a world where land-based oil has nearly vanished. Rising from the sea like industrial monoliths, they keep the last veins of Earth's black blood flowing. Oil Rigs are not suitable to build airfield and no airforce can land on them

22713.upd: Preserves genetically-modified seeds that are required to keep vital crops from going extinct, able to resist the increasingly cold temperatures.

22714.upd: Explores new possibilities to optimise nuclear fusion reactions to generate electricity. A key facility which will drive the future in a world of depleting resources.

8379.upd:

- Indestructible building

22715.upd: Conducts mining activities to find new resources trapped in the ice, potentially allowing for the development of new future technologies.

- Indestructible building

22717.upd: Conducts research on changing marine life and biodiversity in the midst of Nuclear Winter.

8450.unitDesc: Designed to excel in littoral combat, the air-independent propulsion powered submarine is the ultimate silent killer. Taking her out to blue water is strongly discouraged.

2053.unitDesc: Heavy infantry ready to deploy via land or sea in response to a local crisis or flashpoint. Trained in amphibious landings and urban warfare these soldiers bring the fight to the enemy.

2566.unitDesc: Strongest nuclear deterrence weapons platform, equipped to survive and retaliate with deadly precision against any attacking enemy power. Vulnerable in shallow coastal waters (Reduced Damage, 50% HP).

4106.unitDesc:
An unmanned aerial vehicle, which either flies autonomously or is piloted remotely. Generally used for reconnaissance and surveillance. Some drones are armed and even utilize stealth technology. 
IMPORTANT: Unit does not declare war when penetrating foreign airspace.

2060.unitDesc:
Mechanized infantry is especially suited for accompanying heavy armor. Mechanized support and flank protection greatly increases any armored unit's survivability.
Doctrine’s benefits: +25% Soft Damage, +10% Speed

54540.unitDesc: Iron Tide boosts the striking power of cruisers and frigates while tightening their anti-air defenses. Under his command, surface warships strike harder and fend off aerial threats more reliably. His flagship carries heavy batteries designed for sustained shore bombardment.

2573.unitDesc:
Low-flying guided missile predominately used against military ground and sea targets. Launched by air, sea or from the ground and carries a conventional warhead. 
• Deals splash damage within radius of 5

57103.unitDesc: Jaguar navigates helicopter wings through hostile territory, delivering strikes of Wagnerian magnitude. He is the bane of unprotected tanks and ships.

2067.unitDesc:
Special forces infantry trained in rugged terrain and counter-insurgency missions. These elite warriors are the first on the ground and will not wait to occupy territory - instead moving on to their next kill.
- Radar Signature Size: NONE

2580.unitDesc:
Low-flying guided missile predominately used against military ground and sea targets. Launched by air, sea or from the ground and carries a chemical warhead. 
• Deals splash damage within a radius of 10
• Damages friendly units

2587.unitDesc:
Low-flying guided missile predominately used against military ground and sea targets. Launched by air, sea or from the ground and carries a nuclear warhead.
• Deals splash damage within a radius of 10
• Damages friendly units

2075.unitDesc:
Combat vehicle combining decent armor and high mobility to detect, reconnoiter and outmaneuver the enemy. Often used to spearhead an attack, providing mobile surveillance services to the main force. +5% speed in hostile province for army it stacked with.
Doctrine’s benefits: +10% Soft Damage

2594.unitDesc:
Medium range guided ballistic missile following a high trajectory, armed with a conventional warhead. Launched by land or sea, these weapons are used against strategic targets, such as cities. 
• Deals splash damage within radius of 5

5667.unitDesc: These Seasoned Veterans provide invaluable leadership and direction to infantry units, providing strong combat bonuses and ignoring enemy entrenchment. They also have Radar, enabling them to detect enemy armies, providing you with an early warning of incoming threats.

57124.unitDesc: A fixed early-warning radar installation designed to provide limited detection coverage around key locations. Capable of detecting nearby land units at short range. Extremely vulnerable, with no combat capability and minimal resistance against advancing enemy forces. The Radar System is upgraded by further researching Mobile Radar.

2601.unitDesc:
Medium range guided ballistic missile following a high trajectory, armed with a chemical warhead. Launched by land or sea, these weapons are used against strategic targets, such as cities.
• Deals splash damage within a radius of 10
• Damages friendly units

2089.unitDesc:

4.desc: A strong alliance. The nation granting this status publishes its map view to the partner.

2029.description: Grants access to the Security Council, including: Build-Queuing, Rally-Point Placing, Fire-Control Settings, Premium Chat, Membership Privileges, No Inactivity Replacements and more...

3210.name: Reveal Nation's Forces
3210.description: Reveal the targeted nation's armies. Intel gathered at the moment of spy-action execution is visible until day-change.

3213.name: ACCELERATE
3213.description: Accelerates research speed of the current technology by up to 12 hours

22094.name: Helicarrier Mission Reward
22094.description: You have unlocked the ability to research the Helicarrier in all your games.

178.name: Premium Account
178.description:
Players with a Premium Account have access to advanced functionality and usability features:

On all platforms:
  • Build queue for units & buildings
  • Province rally points
  • Shared Intelligence with allies
  • Advanced fire control for units
  • Join matches with Gold features for free
  • Exclusive Premium Account badge
  • More pictures for newspaper articles
  • Recruiting offices for free

Only in Desktop version:
  • Create 1 own match per month (at lvl. 4+)

12372.name: Gather Country Intel
12372.description: Discloses a nation's resources, diplomatic relations, communications, agent positions and unit mobilization.

12374.name: Disrupt Economy
12374.description: Destroys a part of daily local resource production.

3201.name: ACCELERATE
3201.description: Accelerates construction speed of the current building by up to 12 hours

3202.name: ACCELERATE
3202.description: Accelerates mobilization speed of the current unit by up to 12 hours

3203.name: REINFORCE
3203.description: Replenishes the hit points of the selected unit by {amount}%

3204.name: STOCK UP
3204.description: Purchases an amount of the selected resources for gold

3205.name: PREMIUM OFFER
3205.description: Individualized premium offer for the player

3206.name: BOOST MORALE
3206.description: Boosts morale of the selected population by 10%

3207.name: PREMIUM MISSION
3207.description: Hire a specialist for a special mission in this province. The selected mission will be executed immediately.

3208.name: Reveal Local Forces
3208.description: Momentarily reveals any army, owned by any nation, that is located in and around the targeted area at the exact moment the spy action is executed.

50432.helpDescription: EliteArmored Fighting Vehicle still excels at surprising enemies as it can disembark without the need of Harbors, and it uses a special Armed Transport Ship capable of providing increased protection to other Transport Ships on the rivers and seas, as well as move faster on the rivers.
50432.longDescription:
**Elite Armored Fighting Vehicle** is an advanced unit that uses an *Armed Transport Ship on the waters, providing more firepower* than a regular Transport Ship. It excels at River Terrain and serves as a defensive unit on the waters for other Transport Ships.

[image, missions-mission_57]
50432.shortDescription: **Research** the *Elite Armored Fighting Vehicle* that is able to protect itself on the rivers and in coastal waters.
50432.title: Storm of War II

50433.helpDescription: Elite Armored Fighting Vehicle still excels at surprising enemies as it can disembark without the need of Harbors, and it uses a special Armed Transport Ship capable of providing increased protection to other Transport Ships on the rivers and seas, as well as move faster on the rivers.
50433.longDescription:
**Elite Armored Fighting Vehicle** is an advanced unit that uses an *Armed Transport Ship on the waters, providing more firepower* than a regular Transport Ship. It excels at River Terrain and serves as a defensive unit on the waters for other Transport Ships.

[image, missions-mission_58]
50433.shortDescription: **Mobilize** the *Elite Armored Fighting Vehicle* that is able to protect itself on the rivers and in coastal waters.
50433.title: Storm of War III

50434.helpDescription: Frigates are light and economic units that excel against protecting against airborne targets, and they can easily destroy Elite Armored Fighting Vehicle on the seas. Alternatively, Tank Destroyers are Armored units that excel at destroying other Armored units. We will need to research one or the other to prepare to destroy Elite Armored Fighting Vehicles.
50434.longDescription:
Elite Armored Fighting Vehicle excels in surprise tactics, and everyone will utilize them on Rising Tides. **Prepare to defend** against them and research *Frigates* OR *Tank Destroyers* to destroy them on land and sea.

 

[image, missions-mission_59]
50434.shortDescription: **Research** *Frigates* OR *Tank Destroyers* to combat Elite Armored Fighting Vehicles.
50434.title: Menace of Tyranny I

50435.helpDescription: Frigates are light and economic units that excel against protecting against airborne targets, and they can easily destroy Elite Armored Fighting Vehicle on the seas. Alternatively, Tank Destroyers are Armored units that excel at destroying other Armored units. We will need to mobilize one or the other to prepare to destroy Elite Armored Fighting Vehicles.
50435.longDescription:
Elite Armored Fighting Vehicle excels in surprise tactics, and everyone will utilize them on Rising Tides. **Prepare to defend** against them and mobilize *Frigates* OR *Tank Destroyers* to destroy them on land and sea.

[image, missions-mission_60]
50435.shortDescription: **Mobilize** three *Frigates* OR three *Tank Destroyers* to combat Elite Armored Fighting Vehicles.
50435.title: Menace of Tyranny II

50436.helpDescription: To combat the Elite Armored Fighting Vehicles that is effective on land and seas, destroy them using the units we have built for that purpose, Frigates or Tank Destroyers.
50436.longDescription:
Now that we are **ready to face Elite Armored Fighting Vehicles**, *destroy an Elite Armored Fighting Vehicle* on land or seas!

[image, missions-mission_61]
50436.shortDescription: **Destroy** the *Elite Armored Fighting Vehicle* on land or sea!
50436.title: Menace of Tyranny III

50437.helpDescription: Navy is required to wage war on the rivers and seas. Navy is also capable of attacking land units, as they’re almost all ranged units. Researching them will allow us to later mobilize them from Naval Bases and prepare for naval theaters of war.
50437.longDescription:
With **swelling of the rivers and seas** the need for a strong navy is at its highest. *Research any two regular naval units* in preparation to build a navy to conquer the world.

[image, missions-mission_62]
50437.shortDescription: **Research** any *two regular naval units* to start developing a strong navy.
50437.title: Growing Strength I

50438.helpDescription: Navy is required to wage war on the rivers and seas. Navy is also capable of attacking land units, as they’re almost all ranged units. Once researched, we can mobilize them in coastal cities that have Naval Base buildings, and build fleets to dominate naval theaters of war.
50438.longDescription:
With **swelling of the rivers and seas** the need for a strong navy is at its highest. *Mobilize any four regular naval units* as we create a navy to conquer the world.

[image, missions-mission_63]
50438.shortDescription: **Mobilize** any naval units and have at least *four regular naval units*.
50438.title: Growing Strength II

50439.helpDescription: Naval Veterans are strong unit that works best in a fleet (stack), working well as an all-rounder unit good against most other naval units. It is also capable of launching missiles, and is able to detect submarines. At later researched stages, it is capable of being invisible when not in-combat. Once researched, we can mobilize them in coastal cities that have Naval Base buildings.
50439.longDescription:
Our **fleets are ready to scour and destroy all enemies** on the seas and rivers, and to lead them we must *mobilize a Naval Veteran* capable of empowering a fleet and give it the edge in battles.

[image, missions-mission_64]
50439.shortDescription: **Mobilize** a *Naval Veteran* to spearhead your naval theaters of war.
50439.title: Growing Strength III

50440.helpDescription: As you sail the rivers and seas, you will encounter other nation’s fleets. If at war, you can open fire on them from afar or collide to start combat directly, locking both fleets in place. Destroy two naval units throughout your conquest.
50440.longDescription:
With **Naval Veteran ready to lead our fleet**, let us seek out enemies and *destroy two of their naval units*.

[image, missions-mission_66]
50440.shortDescription: **Destroy** two enemy ships after mobilizing a *Naval Veteran*.
50440.title: Never Surrender

50441.helpDescription: Secret Weapons Lab is a building that enables us to build a variety of cutting-edge technology units, as well as to make missiles and pharmaceuticals. It must be built in a city. It is an invisible building, unable to be seen conventionally by other nations.
50441.longDescription:
To surprise surface units, we should acquire an **Elite AIP Submarine that excels in coastal waters**, great for defence of our coastal cities. We must first *build a Secret Weapons Lab* in order to be able to mobilize the submarine.

[image, missions-mission_67]
50441.shortDescription: **Build** a *Secret Weapons Lab* to be able to mobilize a Elite AIP Submarine.
50441.title: Fathoms Deep I

50442.helpDescription: Elite AIP(Air-Independent Propulsion) Submarine is a under-surface unit that excels in littoral (coastal) waters and is extremely effective against naval units. They are weak in the high seas, and they are stealth when not in-combat. It also reveals other stealth submarine units when in-range. To research them, you can do so by choosing the Elite AIP Submarine in the “Seasons” tab of the Research.
50442.longDescription:
To retain **control of coastal waters**, we must *research Elite AIP Submarine* that excels against other naval units in coastal waters, but they are weak on high seas.

[image, missions-mission_68]
50442.shortDescription: **Research** an *Elite AIP Submarine* to begin establishing naval dominion.
50442.title: Fathoms Deep II

50443.helpDescription: Elite AIP(Air-Independent Propulsion) Submarine is a under-surface unit that excels in littoral (coastal) waters and is extremely effective against naval units. They are weak in the high seas, and they are stealth when not in-combat. It also reveals other stealth submarine units when in-range. Once researched, we can mobilize them in coastal cities that have Naval Base buildings. Once researched, you can mobilize them in coastal cities that have Naval Base level 2 buildings.
50443.longDescription:
To maintain **control of coastal waters**, we must *mobilize Elite AIP Submarine* that excels against other naval units in coastal waters, but they are weak on high seas.

[image, missions-mission_69]
50443.shortDescription: **Mobilize** an *Elite AIP Submarine* and rule the coastal seas.
50443.title: Fathoms Deep III

50444.helpDescription: Submarine Veterans are strong unit that works best in a fleet (stack), working well as an all-rounder unit good against most other naval units. It is also capable of launching missiles, and is able to detect submarines. It is stealth when not in-combat. At later researched stages, it is capable of being invisible when not in-combat. Once researched, we can mobilize them in coastal cities that have Naval Base buildings.
50444.longDescription:
Our **Elite AIP Submarine is ready to scour and destroy all enemies** from below on the seas and rivers, and to lead we must *mobilize a Submarine Veteran* capable of outmaneuvering enemies before destroying them.

[image, missions-mission_70]
50444.shortDescription: **Mobilize** a *Submarine Veteran* to lead your submersible weapons of war.
50444.title: Power And Might

50445.helpDescription: Oil Rigs are specific buildings present on Rising Tides 2060. Each nation has their Fuel production reduced due to climate events, and these on-sea Oil Rigs produce a great amount of Fuel, making them a crucial asset. Conquer them to be able to mobilize and upkeep your fleets and armies. Regular infantry cannot disembark on Oil Rigs, you need to use Naval Infantry, Airborne Infantry or Airlift-capable units to capture them.
50445.longDescription:
Rising of the waters of the world flooded all the drill sites on land, leaving mostly the **newly established Oil Rigs that produce Fuel** in high seas. To ensure your nation’s war operations to continue without hinderance, *capture an Oil Rig* to keep fueling your mighty war machinery. You must use Naval Infantry, Airborne Infantry or Airlift-capable units to capture an Oil Rig.

[image, missions-mission_71]
50445.shortDescription: **Capture** an *Oil Rig* to fuel your engines of war.
50445.title: Black Gold I

50446.helpDescription: Oil Rigs are specific buildings present on Rising Tides 2060. Each nation has their Fuel production reduced due to climate events, and these on-sea Oil Rigs produce a great amount of Fuel, making them a crucial asset. Conquer them to be able to mobilize and upkeep your fleets and armies. Regular infantry cannot disembark on Oil Rigs, you need to use Naval Infantry, Airborne Infantry or Airlift-capable units to capture them.
50446.longDescription:
Excellent work! We can use the **newly captured Oil Rig that produce Fuel** to upkeep and expand our fleets and armies. But to grow it even further, *control a total of two Oil Rigs* to contend with any adversary you might find on your path to world domination. You must use Naval Infantry, Airborne Infantry or Airlift-capable units to capture an Oil Rig.

[image, missions-mission_72]
50446.shortDescription: **Capture two** *Oil Rigs* to fuel your engines of war.
50446.title: Black Gold II

50447.helpDescription: Oil Rigs are specific buildings present on Rising Tides 2060. Each nation has their Fuel production reduced due to climate events, and these on-sea Oil Rigs produce a great amount of Fuel, making them a crucial asset. Conquer them to be able to mobilize and upkeep your fleets and armies. Regular infantry cannot disembark on Oil Rigs, you need to use Naval Infantry, Airborne Infantry or Airlift-capable units to capture them.
50447.longDescription:
Magnificent! We can use the **our two Oil Rigs that produce Fuel** to upkeep and expand our fleets and armies to destroy all in our path. One final step lies in securing our domination, *control a total of three Oil Rigs* and ensure your nation survives the Rising Tides! You must use Naval Infantry, Airborne Infantry or Airlift-capable unit to capture an Oil Rig.

[image, missions-mission_73]
50447.shortDescription: **Capture three** *Oil Rigs* to fuel your engines of war.
50447.title: Black Gold III

50448.helpDescription: Deployable Gear is used for expendable units, such as UGVs, drones and now Sea Mines as well. To mobilize Deployable Gear, build Army Base level 1 and mobilize them from the Seasons tab.
50448.longDescription:
We must **acquire Deployable Gear** as we prepare to use it for the *deployment of Sea Mines*!

[image, missions-mission_74]
50448.shortDescription: **Mobilize** *Deployable Gear* to be able to produce expendable technology.
50448.title: Crushing Implosion I

50449.helpDescription: Sea Mines are static weaponry that explodes upon contact with an enemy fleet. This damages them and provides you with valuable information on the movement of fleets. To deploy them, you must have Deployable Gear in-stock. They can be deployed by Destroyers, further developed Corvettes and Elite Frigates.
50449.longDescription:
The waiting game has begun. Your **strategic placement of Sea Mines will be tested**, and rewarded if done well. *Damage an enemy with your Sea Mines* to showcase your strategic prowess!

[image, missions-mission_75]
50449.shortDescription: Have three of your *Sea Mines* **detonated** to deal damage to opposing fleets.
50449.title: Crushing Implosion II

50450.helpDescription:
Read about the unique rules of this scenario.

[step 1, missions-help-mission_77_1, Destroy Mutants and Hives.]
[step 2, missions-help-mission_77_2, Utilize Drone Motherships to attack other ships and mutants from a distance.]
[step 3, missions-help-mission_77_3, Hiveminds can create Mutant Titans, destroy both or face certain destruction!]
50450.longDescription:
World is crumbling as the zombie apocalypse is spreading, and surprisingly, evolving into something far worse. Havens, initially places of refuge against the zombie threat, have all fallen to the plague and became symbols of crushed hope.

**Suppress the evolution**, Mutants *evolve and spawn within hives*, and seek to exterminate humanity as we know it. Fight against them whenever you find them.

**Advanced warfare with Drone Motherships**, To combat threats from safety of territorial waters, *Drone Mothership* can launch drones at enemies on land and sea. Drones can reveal enemy activity, lay Sea Mines and deploy Sabotage Drones that are most efficient against ships and buildings.

**Hiveminds and Mutant Titans**, origin of the mutations comes from the Hives, and more evolved Hiveminds, writhing buildings that create and give higher intelligence to all mutants. Worst of all, they can create *Titans*, large mutants capable of hellish destruction. Do not allow Hives to evolve into a Hivemind and create these monstrous beings against humanity as we know it!


[image, missions-mission_77]
50450.shortDescription: **Read more** about the unique *rules of this scenario*.
50450.title: Survive Z Evolution

50451.helpDescription: Arms Industry is a building that increases all resource and money production within the city it is built-in, and is required for mobilization of Armored, Support, Aerial and Naval units. Building them early gives you a resource-edge over others who fail to do so. The higher the level, more HP the building has, and resource and money production increases greatly on levels 2 and 5.
50451.longDescription:
**Arms Industry** is a building *required for creation of the Elite Drone Mothership*. It also increases resource and money production in the city it’s built in. Building it early-on gives us more production for our survival against Mutants.


[image, missions-mission_78]
50451.shortDescription: **Build** a *level 3 Arms Industry* building that is required for the Elite Drone Mothership.
50451.title: Cutting-Edge Tech I

50452.helpDescription: Naval Base is a building that enables mobilization of Naval units, and serves as a embark/disembark point for land units to be transported over the waters. It is operational as long as it is above 40% HP. It also lightly increases resource production, and decreases embarkation time with each level the building has.
50452.longDescription:
**Naval Base** is a building required for *mobilization of the Elite Drone Mothership*. It allows us to launch Naval units, and Elite Drone Mothership is a fast coastal ship good at hit-and-run tactics with its Drone units.

 

[image, missions-mission_79]
50452.shortDescription: **Build** a *level 2 Naval Base* building that is required for the Elite Drone Mothership.
50452.title: Cutting-Edge Tech II

50453.helpDescription: Elite Drone Mothership is a versatile Naval unit that launches Drones to scout, deal damage to enemy ships and buildings, and drop Sea Mines to protect itself from stronger Naval Units. It is best to build fleets of them for maximum effectiveness, and not take them to Open Seas, as they are slow and vulnerable when not near a coast.
50453.longDescription:
**Elite Drone Mothership** is an advanced Naval unit that uses *Drones* to scout, and attack enemies from afar. We should research it so we can protect against Mutants from the safety of our national waters.

[image, missions-mission_80]
50453.shortDescription: **Research** the *Elite Drone Mothership* capable of launching Drones for coastal hit-and-run tactics.
50453.title: Cutting-Edge Tech III

50454.helpDescription: Elite Drone Mothership is a versatile Naval unit that launches Drones to scout, deal damage to enemy ships and buildings, and drop Sea Mines to protect itself from stronger Naval Units. It is best to build fleets of them for maximum effectiveness, and not take them to Open Seas, as they are slow and vulnerable when not near a coast.
50454.longDescription:
**Elite Drone Mothership** is an advanced unit that uses  *drone units* to attack from safety of coastal Waters. We need to mobilize one to fight Mutants from afar!

[image, missions-mission_81]
50454.shortDescription: **Mobilize** the *Elite Drone Mothership* capable of launching drones while being self-sufficient in the field.
50454.title: Cutting-Edge Tech IV

50455.helpDescription: Explosive Drones are effective against surface naval units, buildings, and mutants. Elite Drone Mothership and the Drone Operator are units that can deploy them, and they require Deployable Gear to be used. The Explosive Drone will self-destruct when it reaches a target.
50455.longDescription:
**Elite Drone Mothership** allows us to deploy various drones, and we must use *Explosive Drone* to quell the Mutant threat from afar.


[image, missions-mission_82]
50455.shortDescription: **Deploy** an *Explosive Drone* that is effective against Mutants.
50455.title: Cutting-Edge Tech V

50456.helpDescription: Sea Drones are effective against naval units. Elite Drone Mothership and the Drone Operator are units that can deploy them, and they require Deployable Gear to be used. The Sea Drone will self-destruct when it reaches a target.
50456.longDescription:
**Elite Drone Mothership** is an advanced unit that can deploy various drones, and we must use *Sea Drone* to damage enemy ships that want to put our Elite Drone Mothership out of commission.


[image, missions-mission_83]
50456.shortDescription: **Elite Drone Mothership** allows us to deploy various drones, and we must use *Sea Drone* to fight back against other nations who want to take out our Elite Drone Mothership.
50456.title: Cutting-Edge Tech VI

50457.helpDescription: ASW Helicopters (Anti-Submarine Warfare) are aerial rotary-wing units, equipped to primarily destroy submarines, but they are very effective against ships and drones alike. They are able to avoid Anti-Air missiles, and if upgraded, reveal stealth units. It requires an Airfield or an Aircraft Carrier to operate from.
50457.longDescription:
Elite Drone Mothership excels in continuous long-range assault, and everyone will utilize them against Mutants. **Prepare to defend** against them and research the *ASW Helicopter* to destroy them off of the water-level surface!

 

[image, missions-mission_84]
50457.shortDescription: **Research** *ASW Helicopter* to combat Elite Drone Motherships from other nations.
50457.title: Cut The Tech I

50458.helpDescription: ASW Helicopters (Anti-Submarine Warfare) are aerial rotary-wing units, equipped to primarily destroy submarines, but they are very effective against ships and drones alike. They are able to avoid Anti-Air missiles, and if upgraded, reveal stealth units. It requires an Airfield or an Aircraft Carrier to operate from.
50458.longDescription:
Elite Drone Mothership excels in continuous long-range assault using multitude of drones, and everyone will utilize them against Mutants. **Prepare to destroy** them by mobilizing the *ASW Helicopter* that is capable of quick strikes and can take out any drones along the way.

 

[image, missions-mission_85]
50458.shortDescription: **Mobilize** a *ASW Helicopter* to prepare to destroy the Elite Drone Motherships from other nations.
50458.title: Cut The Tech II

50459.helpDescription: To combat the Elite Drone Mothership that is effective by deploying drones for a variety of military operations, destroy them to ensure the enemy is crippled against you and Mutants alike.
50459.longDescription:
Now that we are **ready to face Elite Drone Mothership**, *destroy a Elite Drone Mothership* on rivers or seas!

 

[image, missions-mission_86]
50459.shortDescription: **Destroy** an *Elite Drone Mothership* that terrorize from the rivers and the seas!
50459.title: Cut The Tech III

50460.helpDescription:
Howlers are the weakest Mutant unit, effective against soft targets and devastating against population within cities, you should prevent them from reaching any of your cities with everything you have at your disposal. They are hard targets, able to withstand most of firepower that would put ordinary infantry into a hospital or a grave, so prepare accordingly.

Doctor Pasar Sheytani is an unknown figure reaching out to advance his research on how to defeat mutants, or at least that is what he claims. He is not sharing everything he knows about Mutants. He asked us to fight Howlers, a serious rising threat to humanity.
50460.longDescription:
“*Greetings, leaders of the world. I am **Doctor Pasar Sheytani**, an independent researcher battling the evolving mutant plague. Apologies in advance, for this is a one-way transmission.*”
“*I am reaching out to a select few of you who have shown prominence and ambition to be greater than others and to, not only survive but thrive in the world that has fallen to shambles.*
*The recent violent and rapid mutations occurring are a threat to all life, and very much worth investigating. I believe you should directly engage the mutant threat. Please, confront and attempt to defeat the weaker Mutants, vulgarly nicknamed the “Howlers” by the global media. Send me the results once complete, and I will provide you with supplies for your cause.*”

[image, missions-mission_87]
50460.shortDescription: **Destroy** *four Howlers* to suppress the growing mutant threat.
50460.title: Survival of the Fittest I

50461.helpDescription:
Bone Crushers are a strong Mutant unit, effective against soft targets and armored units alike, and still deadly against population within cities, you should prevent them from reaching any of your cities with everything you have at your disposal. They are hard targets, able to withstand most of firepower that would put an ordinary human into a hospital, so prepare accordingly.

Doctor Pasar Sheytani seems to be a dubious figure that speaks, in his one-way transmissions, as if he wants us to fail. Our troops fought bravely, and we will fight back and win against the mutant threat. These new mutants will fall as the last one.
50461.longDescription:
“*It seems that the mutants under-performed against your military strength, surprising. Yes, that is good, thank you for providing the research data. For the next step of the research, it seems the mutants have evolved further. Destroy two Bone Crushers, these larger heavily armed mutations that control machinery. Proceed as we agreed, and you will be handsomely rewarded with my supplies as well as the accolades that will certainly come after we cleanse the world of… this plague.*”

[image, missions-mission_88]
50461.shortDescription: **Destroy** *two Bone Crushers* to prevent the evolving mutants from reaching your cities.
50461.title: Survival of the Fittest II

50462.helpDescription:
Siege Breaker are all-rounder units that are deadly to most armies, and effective against soft targets and armored units alike as well as dangerous to rotary wings and drones. They are hard targets, able to withstand most of firepower that would put an ordinary human into a hospital, so prepare accordingly. It is suggested to attack them from a distance, with aerial units or artillery.

Mutations came from Dr. Sheytani’s lab, making him the only known suspect for this mutation outbreak. His research should lead to something so we should follow through but keep a close eye on him, the supplies we will receive will certainly bolster our chances of survival.
50462.longDescription:
“*Bone Crushers were clearly highly-evolved creatures designed to destroy humanity. You handled them decently, albeit not as clean as I had hoped. Nevertheless, the threat keeps rising. Large mechanical tanks called *Siege Breakers* have crushed a few cities already, and are a threat unlike any you have seen. This global catastrophe happened because, I suspect, the mutagen leaked from my laboratory. Probably by the hand of a bitter or a greedy scientist. We were researching how to revert the zombie plague. My research, and redemption, can now begin. Defeat three of them, and I will reward you for any data you are able to collect.*”

[image, missions-mission_89]
50462.shortDescription: **Destroy** three *Siege Breaker* that can swat rotary wings and drones away, and pose a significant threat to anyone in its path.
50462.title: Survival of the Fittest III

50463.helpDescription:
Mutant Titan is a behemoth able to destroy even the strongest armies head-to-head, take it out from afar, and stop it from reaching your cities or lose them. Hivemind appears if mutations progress too far, making all mutant units much more intelligent and a worse threat to us all. Preventing Hiveminds is necessary for survival, and destroying them should be your highest priority.

Doctor Pasar Sheytani will lead us on no more. Our troops fought bravely, and we will fight back and win against the mutant threat. This has been going on for long enough; the doctor must follow through or face the consequences.
50463.longDescription:
“*Despite great losses, you have accomplished seemingly the improbable. The data you have sent will be very useful indeed. Finally, there is one more step before the research is complete, and my improvement is ready. There is a sinister threat arising, although it might not be revealed yet. Find and destroy, if you can, a large behemoth called the Mutant Titan, its devastation knows no bounds. If you are unable to, instead you could destroy a Hivemind and collect samples for my research, although this task is not much safer either.*”

[image, missions-mission_90]
50463.shortDescription: **Destroy** a *Mutant Titan* OR a *Hivemind* to suppress the worst threat to humanity!
50463.title: Survival of the Fittest IV

50464.helpDescription: Doctor Pasar Sheytani is clearly the one responsible for the mutations, and he slipped from our grasp! Our intelligence cannot track him, as if he disappeared from the face of the Earth. All we can do is prepare to defeat him next time he emerges from the shadows.
50464.longDescription:
“*Thank you for the assistance in my research, but this is sadly where we must part ways. My research was about how easily you can destroy mutants, but the end goal has always been to improve them in their goal to eradicate the flawed mankind, and materialistic wars over land and money. Don’t bother trying to find me, I know how to hide my tracks. Next time you see me, your petty country will be reduced to rubble.*
*Farewell.*”

[image, missions-mission_91]
50464.title: Survival of the //Fittest// Mutants V

50465.helpDescription: Rotary Wing units are quick-response units that are often used for defense against  invading forces, as Rotary Wing units are bound to airfields and potentially the aircraft carriers. Each unit excels against certain units, and is vulnerable against others. Make sure to read their information before researching and deploying them to use ones that are most useful to you.
50465.longDescription:
To surprise surface units, we should acquire an **Elite Attack Helicopter that excels against Armored units**, great for quick deployment in offense and defense against all land units, but especially against Zombies and Mutants. We must first *research any regular Rotary Wing unit* in order to be able to research the Elite Attack Helicopter.

[image, missions-mission_92]
50465.shortDescription: **Research** *one of the regular helicopter units* to be able to research the Elite Attack Helicopter.
50465.title: Show Time I

50466.helpDescription: Excellent quick-response unit that are often used for defense against invading forces, as all Rotary Wing units are bound to airfields and potentially the aircraft carriers. Elite Attack Helicopter is excellent against hard targets and decent against most others. If upgraded, it can be devastating against most threats, and is able to ignore entrenchment when attacking.
50466.longDescription:

50484.longDescription:

**Pharmaceutical Foundries** are new type of Control Points that *provide Pharmaceuticals* regularly so you can maintain combat-readiness at all times. By taking hold of them, you will ensure you approach victory both by domination of Control Points and by strengthening all your armies.

13499.helpDescription:

[step 1, missions-help-mission_1_1, Select any aircraft under your control.]
[step 2, missions-help-mission_1_2, Click '**Patrol**'.]
[step 3, missions-help-mission_1_3, Choose the area you want the aircraft to patrol.]

The aircraft will then fly over the selected area, scanning for any threats. After completing the patrol, it will return for *refueling*. This cycle of patrolling and refueling will continue until you assign a different order. Use this strategy wisely to maintain a watchful eye over your territories. But beware! Patrolling the territories of neutral nations is an act of war!
13499.longDescription:
*Combat Air Patrol* is an important strategy to monitor and secure your territories from the sky. Aircraft are quick, effective, and provide a significant advantage in surveying and protecting your territory.

[image, missions-mission_1_set_combat_air_patrol]
