[step 1, missions-help-mission_2_1, Select your infantry unit.]
[step 2, missions-help-mission_2_2, Click '**Attack**'.]
[step 3, missions-help-mission_2_3, Choose the *province* you want to conquer.]

By successfully attacking and capturing *provinces*, you grow your influence and power. Remember, victory favors the bold.
13500.longDescription:
*Conquering provinces* is a key strategy to expand your control and gain **Victory Points**, additional *manpower* and *money*. Only infantry units have the ability to **capture provinces**, excluding *Special Forces* Infantry.

[image, missions-mission_2_conquer_a_province]
13500.shortDescription: Use *infantry* to attack and **conquer a province**.
13500.title: Preliminary Foothold!

13501.helpDescription:
To conquer a *city*, follow these steps:

[step 1, missions-help-mission_4_1, Select your infantry units.]
[step 2, missions-help-mission_4_2, Click 'Attack'.]
[step 3, missions-help-mission_4_3, Choose the *city* you want to conquer.]

Capturing cities is not easy due to the enhanced defenses, but the rewards are often worth the challenge. Keep expanding your territory, and your power will grow in turn.
13501.longDescription:
*Conquering cities* strengthens your strategic position and economy, extends your defensive position and giving you valuable extra resources. Only infantry units can accomplish this task. Keep in mind that defending units in a city gain an **entrenchment bonus**, increasing their defensive power. 

[image, missions-mission_3_conquer_a_city]
13501.shortDescription: Command your *infantry* to attack and **conquer a city**.
13501.title: Urban Dominance!

13502.helpDescription:
To include Motorized Infantry in your army, you must research them first. Here are the steps:

[step 1, missions-help-mission_5_1, Open the research panel.]
[step 2, missions-help-mission_5_2, Find the Motorized Infantry unit.]
[step 3, missions-help-mission_5_3, Click 'Research' and wait until it finishes.]

After the research is done, you can use these units in the field. You can make them stronger by researching more in the Motorized Infantry area. This will increase their level and improve their skills. Keep strengthening your army and lead your people to victory.
13502.longDescription:
*Motorized Infantry* are fast, cost-effective units good at defending *cities* and capturing new *provinces*. They are not the strongest offensive units, but when supported by defenses like bunkers, they can resist attacks from enemy ground forces. However, they are less protected against artillery and air attacks. 

[image, missions-mission_5_research_motorized_infantry]
13502.shortDescription: **Research** *Motorized Infantry* to form the backbone of your army.
13502.title: Strengthen Your Army's Backbone!

13503.helpDescription:
To accomplish this mission, follow these steps:

[step 1, missions-help-mission_3_1, Select your infantry units.]
[step 2, missions-help-mission_3_2, Click 'Attack'.]
[step 3, missions-help-mission_3_3, Click 'Waypoint' and select the provinces you want to conquer, one after the other.]

Remember, the journey to bring a nation to its knees is a marathon, not a sprint. It requires strategic planning and patient execution. Once you succeed, your dominance in the world arena will be unquestioned.
13503.longDescription:
The ultimate show of power is to defeat an entire *nation*. This involves capturing *provinces* and *cities* that a *nation* owns. Each *province* and *city* is worth **Victory Points (VPs)**, and a *nation* is considered defeated when its **Victory Points** fall to zero. A *nation’s* **Victory Point** count can be viewed in the diplomacy screen. 

[image, missions-mission_4_defeat_nation]
13503.shortDescription: Bring {nationName} to its knees by **conquering all its territory**.
13503.title: Absolute Triumph!

13504.helpDescription:
To start researching the Air Superiority Fighter, follow these steps:

[step 1, missions-help-mission_6_1, Open the research panel.]
[step 2, missions-help-mission_6_2, Find the Air Superiority Fighter unit.]
[step 3, missions-help-mission_6_3, Click 'Research' and wait for it to complete.]

Once the research is finished, you can use these units in the field. Additional research will increase their level and enhance their capabilities. A strong air force can be a game changer in any conflict, so invest wisely.
13504.longDescription:
The **Air Superiority Fighter** is a high-speed, powerful aircraft designed to rule the skies. Researching this unit will unlock its potential for your army. 

[image, missions-mission_6_research_air_superiority_fighter]
13504.shortDescription: Complete the **research** for the *Air Superiority Fighter*.
13504.title: Enhance Your Aerial Dominance!

13505.helpDescription:
To begin the research on the Infantry Veteran, follow these steps:

[step 1, missions-help-mission_7_1, Open the research panel.]
[step 2, missions-help-mission_7_2, Find the Infantry Veteran unit.]
[step 3, missions-help-mission_7_3, Click 'Research' and wait until it's completed.]

After the research is complete, you can add Infantry Veteran to your forces. Further research will enhance their level and abilities. Investing in your command structure can turn the tide of battles, giving your infantry units the edge they need.
13505.longDescription:
The **Infantry Veteran** is a crucial asset, providing significant boosts to infantry units. They not only increase the overall strength of the infantry but also possess the unique ability to neutralize the *entrenchment bonus* of defenders. 

[image, missions-mission_7_research_infantry_officer]
13505.shortDescription: Complete the **research** for the *Infantry Veteran* unit.
13505.title: Introduce Army Leadership!

13506.helpDescription:
To construct an Army Base, follow these steps:

[step 1, missions-help-mission_8_1, Click on the city where you want the Army Base.]
[step 2, missions-help-mission_8_2, Click the 'Build' button.]
[step 3, missions-help-mission_8_3, Find and select 'Army Base'. Click 'Construct' next to it.]

After these steps, construction of the Army Base will begin. Complete this process in three different cities. Remember, the strength of your forces is not just in numbers, but also in the strategic positioning of your bases.
13506.longDescription:
**Army Bases** are vital infrastructure that allows you to mobilize various infantry units. They form the backbone of your ground operations. 

[image, missions-mission_8_construct_army_bases]
13506.title: Prepare Your Forces For Mobilization!

13507.helpDescription:
To construct an Arms Industry, follow these steps:

[step 1, missions-help-mission_9_1, Select the city where you want the Arms Industry.]
[step 2, missions-help-mission_9_2, Click the 'Build' button.]
[step 3, missions-help-mission_9_3, Find and select 'Arms Industry'. Click 'Construct' next to it.]

Once construction begins, your city will soon be a hub of resource production, accelerating your nation's ability to field and support military units. Remember, the war machine runs on resources, and a well-placed Arms Industry can be a significant advantage.
13507.longDescription:
The **Arms Industry** is a key facility that boosts the production of resources in the *city* it's located in. It forms an essential part of your *nation*'s war effort. It is a requirement for the *mobilization* of many units.

[image, missions-mission_9_construct_arms_industry_v2]
13507.shortDescription: **Build** an *Arms Industry* to improve your nation’s economy. It is also a **pre-requisite** for some units.
13507.title: Start Establishing Your Economy!

13508.helpDescription:
To construct a Local Industry, follow these steps:

[step 1, missions-help-mission_10_1, Select the resource-producing province where you want the Local Industry.]
[step 2, missions-help-mission_10_2, Click the 'Build' button.]
[step 3, missions-help-mission_10_3, Find and select 'Local Industry'. Click 'Construct' next to it.]

Once the Local Industry is under construction, it will soon enhance the production of resources in that province. Choose wisely, and your investment in Local Industries can greatly fuel your expansion and military efforts.
13508.longDescription:
**Local Industries** can enhance the production of the 5 main resources in the *provinces* where they are built. The resources that this building can boost are **Supplies**, **Components**, **Fuel**, **Electronics**, and **Rare Materials**. Building a **Local Industry** in a *province* that does not produce any of these resources would be wasted. Make sure to check whether the *province* is producing a resource other than **Manpower** and **Money** before building **Local Industries**. 

[image, missions-mission_10_construct_local_industry]
13508.title: Promote Local Endeavours For Economic Growth!

13509.helpDescription:
To build an Airbase, follow these steps:

[step 1, missions-help-mission_11_1, Select the city where you want to build the Airbase.]
[step 2, missions-help-mission_11_2, Click the 'Build' button.]
[step 3, missions-help-mission_11_3, Find and select 'Airbase'. Click 'Construct' next to it.]

Once construction begins, your Airbase will soon be ready to launch and receive air units. This crucial addition can greatly enhance your military capabilities and flexibility, as well as speed up the deployment of your infantry units.
13509.longDescription:
**Airbases** are strategic installations that allow you to deploy air units like fighters, helicopters, and bombers. They also enable *cities* to receive air transports carrying units with the necessary air-lifting ability. 

[image, missions-mission_11_construct_air_base]
13509.shortDescription: **Build** a new *Airbase* to initiate your arial dominance.
13509.title: Operation Bird Nest!

13510.helpDescription:
To construct a Military Hospital, follow these steps:

[step 1, missions-help-mission_12_1, Select the city where you want to build the Military Hospital.]
[step 2, missions-help-mission_12_2, Click the 'Build' button.]
[step 3, missions-help-mission_12_3, Find and select 'Military Hospital'. Click 'Construct' next to it.]

Once the construction starts, your city will soon have a facility that helps restore the health of your damaged units. This will allow you to maintain a robust defense and sustain longer offensives, giving you a significant advantage in prolonged conflicts.
13510.longDescription:
**Military Hospitals** are vital facilities that allow your units stationed in the *city* to recover health over time. Keeping your forces healthy is crucial for maintaining your strength in the field. 

[image, missions-mission_12_construct_1_military_hospital]
13510.shortDescription: **Build** a *Military Hospital*. This will improve your city's **population growth**, and enhance the **healing rate** of your armies in this city!
13510.title: Healthy Solutions!

13511.helpDescription:
To construct an Underground Bunkers, follow these steps:

[step 1, missions-help-mission_13_1, Select the city where you want to build the Underground Bunkers.]
[step 2, missions-help-mission_13_2, Click the 'Build' button.]
[step 3, missions-help-mission_13_3, Find and select 'Underground Bunkers'. Click 'Construct' next to it.]

Once construction begins, your city will soon have a facility that strengthens your defenses and keeps the morale of your people high. A resilient defense and high morale are key to enduring any conflict.
13511.longDescription:
**Underground Bunkers** are unique structures that can only be built in *cities*. They not only provide an *entrenchment bonus* to your units, but also boost the *morale* of the local population. 

[image, missions-mission_13_construct_underground_bunker]
13511.shortDescription: **Build** *Underground Bunkers* to provide stronger entrenchment to your garrisoned units.
13511.title: Metropolitan Defense!

13512.helpDescription:
To mobilize an Air Superiority Fighter, follow these steps:

[step 1, missions-help-mission_15_1, Click on a city with an Airbase.]
[step 2, missions-help-mission_15_2, Click the 'Mobilize' button.]
[step 3, missions-help-mission_15_3, Find 'Air Superiority Fighter'. Click 'Mobilize' next to it.]

Once mobilized, your Air Superiority Fighter will be ready to engage and control the skies. Remember, air superiority can be a decisive factor in any conflict.
13512.longDescription:
The **Air Superiority Fighter** is a vital unit designed to dominate the skies. It excels in combating enemy air units, although it's less effective against ground forces. An **Airbase** and **Arms Industry** is required to mobilize this unit. 

[image, missions-mission_15_mobilize_air_superiority_fighter]
13512.shortDescription: **Mobilize** an *Air Superiority Fighter* to defend your airspace.
13512.title: Establish your aerial defenses!

13513.helpDescription:
To mobilize Motorized Infantry, follow these steps:

[step 1, missions-help-mission_14_1, Click on a city with an Army Base.]
[step 2, missions-help-mission_14_2, Click the 'Mobilize' button.]
[step 3, missions-help-mission_14_3, Under the 'Infantry' tab, find 'Motorized Infantry'. Click 'Mobilize' next to it.]

Repeat these steps to mobilize three Motorized Infantry units. Remember, building Recruitment Offices in the city can reduce the mobilization time. Mobilize these units and let's start extending our control.
13513.longDescription:
**Motorized Infantry** units are cost-effective and perfect for early game strategies. Their speed and versatility are crucial in establishing a strong foothold. 

[image, missions-mission_14_mobilize_motorized_infantry]
13513.title: Begin Army Enlistment!

13514.helpDescription:
To split a unit stack, follow these steps:

[step 1, missions-help-mission_16_1, Select the unit stack you want to split.]
[step 2, missions-help-mission_16_2, Click the 'Split' button.]
[step 3, missions-help-mission_16_3, Select the amounts of each unit you want in your new stack]

Remember, while strength in numbers is a sound strategy, the ability to adapt to changing circumstances can often turn the tide in your favor.
13514.longDescription:
In the theater of war, flexibility is key. While combining units into a single *stack* can provide concentrated power, there are times when you need to split these *stacks* to adapt to changing battlefield conditions or to give specific orders to individual units or *stacks*. 

[image, missions-mission_16_split_unit_stacks]
13514.title: Divide and Conquer!

13515.helpDescription:
To airlift a unit, follow these steps:

[step 1, missions-help-mission_17_1, Check the unit's info card to confirm it has airlift capabilities.]
[step 2, missions-help-mission_17_2, Select the unit to be airlifted.]
[step 3, missions-help-mission_17_3, Click the Move Button and select the destination airport.]

Remember, the ability to swiftly reposition your forces can provide a critical advantage in the theatre of war. Use airlifting wisely to maintain the upper hand.
13515.longDescription:
The ability to *airlift* units across great distances quickly can be a strategic game changer. However, not all units are capable of being *airlifted*. It's crucial to check a unit's info card to see if it has airlift capabilities. Some units like the **Motorized Infantry** can be *airlifted* immediately, while others, like the **Mechanized Infantry**, require specific research levels to be *airlifted*. 

[image, missions-mission_17_airlift_unit]
13515.shortDescription: **Transport** a unit between two different *Air Bases* or *Airfields*.
13515.title: Sky Shuttle!

13516.helpDescription:
To switch to Political View, follow these steps:

[step 1, missions-help-mission_18_1, Go to 'More' section on mobile or the Globe Icon, both located at the bottom right of the screen.]
[step 2, missions-help-mission_18_2, Open the 'View' menu.]
[step 3, missions-help-mission_18_3, Toggle the 'Political View' on.]

With the world now in Political View, you can easily distinguish the territories of each nation. Remember, understanding the geopolitical landscape is key to strategic planning and execution.
13516.longDescription:
The *Political View* provides a different perspective of the world, distinguishing every *nation* by color. This can make it easier to visualize the territories and borders of each *nation*, providing valuable strategic insight. 

[image, missions-mission_18_toggle_political_map_view]
13516.title: Change of Perspective!

13517.helpDescription:
To message another player, follow these steps:

[step 1, missions-help-mission_19_1, Click on the 'Diplomacy' icon, represented by a bird symbol.]
[step 2, missions-help-mission_19_2, Find the player you contacted before or find them by choosing 'Start a new conversation'.]
[step 3, missions-help-mission_19_3, Send them a message.]

Remember to be respectful when communicating with other players. Your diplomatic approach can greatly influence the course of your nation's journey. Forge alliances, negotiate deals, or discuss strategies, but always maintain the spirit of sportsmanship.
13517.longDescription:
In the world of warfare, *diplomacy* plays a crucial role. Communication with other human players can lead to strategic alliances, peace agreements, or even prevent unwanted conflicts. 

[image, missions-mission_19_message_another_player]
13517.title: Open Diplomatic Channels!

13518.helpDescription:
To create or join a coalition, follow these steps:

[step 1, missions-help-mission_20_1, Select the 'Coalitions' button.]
[step 2, missions-help-mission_20_2, To join an existing coalition, click on the desired coalition and press 'Apply'.]
[step 3, missions-help-mission_20_3, Alternatively, to create a new coalition, go to 'Create Coalition' button at the bottom.]


Remember, when naming your coalition, ensure that you adhere to the game's Terms of Service and maintain respectfulness. By forming or joining a coalition, you open up new possibilities for alliances and strategic partnerships. Together, you can shape the course of the world.
13518.longDescription:
**Coalitions** are powerful alliances formed between *nations*. By joining forces with other players, you can combine your military power and knowledge to become a formidable entity on the global stage. 

[image, missions-mission_20_join_or_create_coalition]
13518.title: Forge a Military Pact!

13519.helpDescription:
To publish an article, follow these steps:

[step 1, missions-help-mission_21_1, Click on the 'More' button at the bottom right of the screen on mobile, or the 'NEWS' button on the top left of the screen.]
[step 2, missions-help-mission_21_2, Navigate to 'Newspaper' on mobile or to 'Write Article' tab.]
[step 3, missions-help-mission_21_3, Write and submit your article.]

Remember to be respectful when writing articles. Consider the feelings of other players and maintain a positive community spirit. Your words can inspire, educate, or entertain - use this platform wisely to contribute to the vibrant WW3 community.
13519.longDescription:
The **News** are an in-game newspaper that allows you to share your thoughts, strategies, and experiences with other players. It's a great way to engage with the community and voice your perspective. 

[image, missions-mission_21_publish_con_news_article]
13519.title: Read All About It!

13520.helpTitle: Making buy offers on the market
13520.helpDescription:
To purchase resources, follow these steps:

[step 1, missions-help-mission_22_1, Select 'Market' on mobile in the bottom of the screen or select the 'Market' at the top middle of the screen.]
[step 2, missions-help-mission_22_2, Choose desired resource and the offer that suits you from the offers listed.]
[step 3, missions-help-mission_22_3, Purchase 100 units of the resource using in-game cash or gold.]

Remember, managing your resources effectively is a key aspect of strategy. Utilize the market to supplement your production and meet your nation's needs.
13520.longDescription:
The market is a vital platform for acquiring resources that you may lack. Whether it's materials for construction or supplies for your troops, the market can be a strategic asset in your expansion plans. 

[image, missions-mission_23_market_sell_offer]
13520.title: Resource Buyout!

13521.helpTitle: Making sell offers on the market
13521.helpDescription:
To sell resources, follow these steps:

[step 1, missions-help-mission_23_1,  Select 'Market' on mobile in the bottom of the screen or select the 'Market' at the top middle of the screen.]
[step 2, missions-help-mission_23_2, Choose 'Create Offer' and select the resource you want to sell, setting the amount and price per resource.]
[step 3, missions-help-mission_23_3, Click 'Create' to list your offer on the market.]

Remember, players are always looking for resources. Set a competitive price to attract buyers and maximize your profits. Trading resources can be a lucrative part of your economic strategy, so keep an eye on market trends and adjust your prices accordingly.
13521.longDescription:
As your *nation* grows and your production increases, you may find yourself with an excess of certain resources. Selling these resources on the market can be a great way to earn some extra **money** or **gold**. 

[image, missions-mission_23_market_sell_offer]
13521.title: Exportation Strategy!

13522.helpDescription:
To buy a Gold package, do the following:

[step 1, missions-help-mission_24_1, Select the 'Gold Bars' icon in the top right on mobile, or select the 'Gold Shopping Cart' icon on the top right corner of your screen!]
[step 2, missions-help-mission_24_2, Select a gold package of your choosing!]
[step 3, missions-help-mission_24_3, Input required information and purchase it!]

**Why Gold Matters?**: Gold isn't just a shiny treat — it helps you in matches to acquire resources or speed up various processes!
**Support the Game**: Your purchase helps us continuously bring fresh, exciting content to you!
13522.longDescription:
**Gold**, a premium resource, can dramatically enhance your gameplay, expediting progress and opening up unique advantages.

[image, missions-mission_24_purchase_gold]
13522.title: Get An Edge On The Competition!

13523.helpTitle: Updating your account name and e-mail
13523.helpDescription:
To update your username and e-mail address, follow these steps:

[step 1, missions-help-mission_25_1, If you are inside a match select the 'Home' icon to return to the HUB.]
[step 2, missions-help-mission_25_2, On the match selection screen, select the 'More' menu on the lower right corner on mobile, or the 'Settings' Cog icon.]
[step 3, missions-help-mission_25_3, Select the option to change the e-mail or your username.]

Remember, your username is how other players recognize you, and your e-mail ensures you're notified about important updates. Keep in mind that your username can only be changed once so this is your opportunity to define yourself!
13523.longDescription:
As you navigate through the world of conflict and diplomacy, maintaining an updated profile is crucial. Changing your **username** or **e-mail address** is simple and ensures you're always connected. 

[image, missions-mission_25_update_player_name_and_email]
13523.shortDescription: Update your username and e-mail address.
13523.title: Identity and Security!

13524.helpDescription:
To start a new match, follow these steps:

[step 1, missions-help-mission_26_1, While outside of a match, select 'Games' tab at the bottom of the screen on mobile, or select 'Matches' tab.]
[step 2, missions-help-mission_26_2, Select the 'Quick Join' tab.]
[step 3, missions-help-mission_26_3, Find a match you like and select 'Join Now!'.]

Remember, each match represents unique obstacles and opportunities, requiring different tactics to achieve victory. By opening a new front, you're challenging yourself to adapt and evolve, sharpening your strategic skills in the process. So, let's march onto new battlefields!
13524.longDescription:
The world is vast, and there are many fronts on which to prove your strategic prowess. Expanding your operations and starting a **second match** can be an exciting way to *explore new challenges* and strategies. 

[image, missions-mission_26_join_another_map]
13524.shortDescription: **Join** a *second match* and open a new battlefront.
13524.title: The Second Front!

13525.helpDescription:
To be prepared for war in the Rising Tides, remember the following:

[step 1, missions-help-mission_27_1, Each City Complex is worth 50 Victory Points after a day of charging, as well as granting other boons.]
[step 2, missions-help-mission_27_2, Offering a great deal of resources to one controlling them, Strategic Sites give 500 Victory Points making them the most valuable lands to fight for.]
[step 3, missions-help-mission_27_3, Violent and exceptionally strong dissident group rises against governments wherever there is low morale. Maintain happiness of your people, or incur the wrath of the deadly Chosen.]
13525.longDescription:
As the oceans rise, nations are desperate to protect their borders and **secure their city complexes**, while the fight for *control of the Strategic Sites*, bountiful with resources, is just beginning.

Prepare for the conflict as wars are declared, and the anarchic group called the Chosen rises wherever there is turmoil, in Conflict of Nations: Rising Tides. 

[image, missions-mission_27_get_your_special_operative_on_the_ground]
13525.shortDescription: **Read more** about the unique *rules of this scenario*.
13525.title: Survive the Rising Tides

13526.helpDescription: As the world shatters, nations rush for regional hegemony. Former great powers have fragmented, and new empires can emerge. Victory strategy sites can be conquered around the map.
13526.longDescription: Conquer Strategic Sites - Offering a great deal of resources to one controlling them, Strategic Sites give 500 Victory Points making them the most valuable lands to fight for.
13526.shortDescription: **Read more** about the unique *rules of this scenario*.
13526.title: A World Divided (10X)

13527.helpDescription: As the world shatters, nations rush for regional hegemony. Former great powers have fragmented, and new empires can emerge. Victory strategy sites can be conquered around the map.
13527.longDescription: Conquer Strategic Sites - Offering a great deal of resources to one controlling them, Strategic Sites give 500 Victory Points making them the most valuable lands to fight for.
13527.shortDescription: **Read more** about the unique *rules of this scenario*.
13527.title: A World Divided (4X)

13528.helpDescription:
To gain **Victory Points** (VPs), players can *conquer opposing cities or provinces* using infantry units. Cities offer the most victory points and benefits for capturing, but also tend to be harder to hold. To capture a city, follow these steps:

[step 1, missions-help-mission_4_1, Select your infantry units.]
[step 2, missions-help-mission_4_2, Click 'Attack'.]
[step 3, missions-help-mission_4_3, Choose the *city* you want to conquer.]

This map comes with special structures that you can capture called 'Complexes'. When fully charged, a Shielded Complex grants 50 Victory Points. Continue expanding your territory to increase your power and influence.
13528.longDescription: **Accumulate** 2000 Victory Points to *permanently unlock* the powerful Helicarrier for your account. Once unlocked, you can research and deploy this unit in all your future matches.
13528.shortDescription: **Read more** about the unique *rules of this scenario*.
13528.title: Apocalypse Armada

13529.helpDescription:
**Satellites** are elite reconnaissance units that allow you to *spy on your opponent's* army movement. They are capable of moving across vast distances, and are able to observe a wide area of the battlefield. 

Due to their position in orbit, they are hidden from view, and difficult to locate. This allows you to observe enemy movement even in their own territory without being detected. 

If you suspect a hostile power is using Satellites, the easiest way to counter them is to identify if your opponent has very high level Airbases, which are required to mobilize and retain control of the Satellite. If this Airbase is destroy, the Satellite will be unable to maintain orbit, and will be destroyed. Make use of Agents, Stealth units such as Special Forces, or long-range Heavy Bombers to destroy these Airbases.
13529.longDescription:
In modern warfare, information is power. Begin by **researching Satellite** technology. This crucial first step will set the foundation for *superior reconnaissance* efforts. Commander, let's stay ahead of our foes, and get our satellites up in the air quickly.

[image, missions-mission_29_reach_for_the_skies]
13529.shortDescription: **Research** *Satellite* technology to advance towards Skywatch Protocol.
13529.title: Reach for the Skies!

13530.helpDescription:
**Satellites** are elite reconnaissance units that allow you to *spy on your opponent's* army movement. They are capable of moving across vast distances, and are able to observe a wide area of the battlefield. 

Due to their position in orbit, they are hidden from view, and difficult to locate. This allows you to observe enemy movement even in their own territory without being detected. 

If you suspect a hostile power is using Satellites, the easiest way to counter them is to identify if your opponent has very high level Airbases, which are required to mobilize and retain control of the Satellite. If this Airbase is destroy, the Satellite will be unable to maintain orbit, and will be destroyed. Make use of Agents, Stealth units such as Special Forces, or long-range Heavy Bombers to destroy these Airbases.
13530.longDescription:
**Improving our Satellite** technology will enable us to *gather intelligence across a wider region*. We should invest into the research necessary to boost our satellites coverage.

[image, missions-mission_29_reach_for_the_skies]
13530.title: Surveillance Blanket!

13531.helpDescription:
**Satellites** are elite reconnaissance units that allow you to *spy on your opponent's* army movement. They are capable of moving across vast distances, and are able to observe a wide area of the battlefield. 

Due to their position in orbit, they are hidden from view, and difficult to locate. This allows you to observe enemy movement even in their own territory without being detected. 

If you suspect a hostile power is using Satellites, the easiest way to counter them is to identify if your opponent has very high level Airbases, which are required to mobilize and retain control of the Satellite. If this Airbase is destroy, the Satellite will be unable to maintain orbit, and will be destroyed. Make use of Agents, Stealth units such as Special Forces, or long-range Heavy Bombers to destroy these Airbases.
13531.longDescription:
Our **scientists** have identified a potential *breakthrough in our satellite research*. We should provide them with the resources necessary to see it through!

[image, missions-mission_29_reach_for_the_skies]
13531.title: Orbital Conquest!

13532.helpDescription:
**Satellites** are elite reconnaissance units that allow you to *spy on your opponent's* army movement. They are capable of moving across vast distances, and are able to observe a wide area of the battlefield. 

Due to their position in orbit, they are hidden from view, and difficult to locate. This allows you to observe enemy movement even in their own territory without being detected. 

If you suspect a hostile power is using Satellites, the easiest way to counter them is to identify if your opponent has very high level Airbases, which are required to mobilize and retain control of the Satellite. If this Airbase is destroy, the Satellite will be unable to maintain orbit, and will be destroyed. Make use of Agents, Stealth units such as Special Forces, or long-range Heavy Bombers to destroy these Airbases.
13532.longDescription:
With our research efforts complete, the next step is to **deploy the Satellite**. We will need to *upgrade an Airbase* to be able to maintain a satellite-uplink. It is imperative we protect this airbase, or the satellite will be destroyed.

[image, missions-mission_28_initiate_skywatch_protocol]
13532.title: Initiate Skywatch Protocol!

13533.helpTitle: What is the Elite Special Forces?
13533.helpDescription:
**Elite Special Forces** excel at hit-and-run strikes. They are capable of *dealing heavy damage to isolated enemy armies* that are on the move. By using Stealth, they are able to move behind enemy lines, and catch enemy reinforcements off-guard. Deploy these units in-between enemy provinces, and have them hit isolated pockets of enemy units.

Using your reconnaissance units, you can identify the paths your opponent's forces are taking to get to the front. Use this information to position your commandos in the right paths to deal the most damage.
13533.longDescription:
With better insights into enemy troop movement, we can **deploy our commandos** to *ambush enemy armies*. Begin research into the Elite Special Forces, and we can begin hitting enemy targets behind enemy lines.

[image, missions-mission_13_construct_underground_bunker]
13533.title: I've got a present for ya!

13534.helpDescription:
**UAVs** are autonomous aerial vehicles that are primarily used for *reconnaissance and surveillance*. They are capable of spotting, and identifying enemy armies from relative safety, and allow you to track their movements.

At higher research levels, they can be equipped with Cruise Missiles - allowing them to target hostile forces. Unlike other aircraft, they are capable of flying into another nation's territory without declaring war. Be aware, just because they won't trigger war, does not mean the leader of that nation won't consider it as a potentially hostile act.
13534.longDescription:
**UAVs** provide us with a cheaper alternative to the satellite to be able to *gather intelligence on enemy troop movements*. We should consider investing into them to help us plug holes in our satellite coverage.

[image, missions-mission_31_advanced_recon_support]
13534.shortDescription: **Research** *UAV* technology to supplement our intel-gathering efforts.
13534.title: Eye in the Sky!

13535.helpDescription:
**Mobile Radar** units are purely support vehicles that *have a very large radar range*. This allows them to track army movements across borders in the relative safety of your territory.

At higher research levels, their radar systems become more sensitive - allowing them to detect low siganture units, and at greater distances. At their highest research level, they are capable of detecting units with Stealth capabilities.
13535.longDescription:
Mobile-Radar units provide our units with early-detection of nearby enemy troop movements. We should consider investing into mobile radar technology to allow us to track the movements of enemy armies.

[image, missions-mission_34_eyes_on_the_ground]
13535.title: Beacon of Surveillance!

13536.helpDescription:
**UAVs** are autonomous aerial vehicles that are primarily *used for reconnaissance and surveillance*. They are capable of spotting, and identifying enemy armies from relative safety, and allow you to track their movements.

At higher research levels, they can be equipped with Cruise Missiles - allowing them to target hostile forces. Unlike other aircraft, they are capable of flying into another nation's territory without declaring war. Be aware, just because they won't trigger war, does not mean the leader of that nation won't consider it as a potentially hostile act.
13536.longDescription:
Now that we have UAV technology researched, we should deploy a UAV to begin keeping an eye on any potential hostile enemy.

[image, missions-mission_30_add_missile_support]
13536.title: Overwatch!

13537.helpDescription:
**Mobile Radar** units are purely support vehicles that *have a very large radar range*. This allows them to track army movements across borders in the relative safety of your territory.

At higher research levels, their radar systems become more sensitive - allowing them to detect low siganture units, and at greater distances. At their highest research level, they are capable of detecting units with Stealth capabilities.
13537.longDescription:
We are ready to deploy our first mobile-radar unit. We should order the mobilization of a mobile-radar unit when possible, Commander.

[image, missions-mission_33_expert_radar_detection]
13537.title: Expanding Surface Area!

13538.helpDescription:
**Elite Special Forces** excel at hit-and-run strikes. They are capable of dealing *heavy damage to isolated enemy armies* that are on the move. By using Stealth, they are able to move behind enemy lines, and catch enemy reinforcements off-guard. Deploy these units in-between enemy provinces, and have them hit isolated pockets of enemy units.

Using your reconnaissance units, you can identify the paths your opponent's forces are taking to get to the front. Use this information to position your commandos in the right paths to deal the most damage.
13538.longDescription:
Our commandos are ready to deploy, they're just waiting on your orders to mobilize.

[image, missions-mission_27_get_your_special_operative_on_the_ground]
13538.title: Keep'em comin'!

13539.helpDescription: The Drone Operator is a support unit that carries several useful drones which they can launch to accomplish diverse objectives. The Drone Operator himself is not trained for direct combat, and should be protected properly from all threats.
13539.longDescription:
The **Drone Operator** automates your frontline forces and *minimizes your losses* in your fight against the undead. As the hordes continue to ravage the world, *protecting your key forces* from infection is essential. 

[image, missions-mission_36_automated_vanguard]
13539.shortDescription: Complete the second **research** for the *Drone Operator*.
13539.title: Automated Vanguard!

13540.helpDescription: The Drone Operator is a support unit that carries several useful drones which they can launch to accomplish diverse objectives. The Drone Operator himself is not trained for direct combat, and should be protected properly from all threats.
13540.longDescription:
The **Drone Operator** is only the first step in automating your frontline forces. When you have enough *Deployable Gear*, use your Drone Operator to deploy your first drone. Now’s your chance to turn the tide against the undead.

[image, missions-mission_36_omni_operator]
13540.shortDescription: **Mobilize** a *Drone Operator* to fight the Undead.
13540.title: Attack of the Drones!

13541.helpDescription:
The Drones are unmanned automated aerial units that serve numerous tasks:
The Recon Drone is used to patrol and spot enemies in a short distance of the Drone Operator. The Recon Drone can only operate for a few hours so use it wisely.
The Explosive Drone is used to deal damage to soft targets, and deal attrition to them. At higher level, the Explosive Drone can ignore fortifications to still wreak havoc on entrentched armies.
The Sabotage Drone is used to damage buildings, disrupting production and construction in enemy territory. The Sabotage Drone is also able to damage naval units, potentially intimidating navies into keeping distance from the shore.
13541.longDescription:
The **Drones** have a variety of offensive and reconnaissance capabilities that can spell the difference between doom or survival for your nation. Explore these *different options* and find your optimal strategy!

[image, missions-mission_36_attack_of_the_drones]
13541.shortDescription: **Deploy** one of each *Drone* type to establish a versatile vanguard.
13541.title: Omni-Operator!

13542.helpDescription: The Elite Attack Aircraft is devastating against ground units, both against soft and hard targets. It is weak against other air units, and not well-suited against sea units. Use it to quickly destroy ground units, and protect them from enemy airborne units.
13542.longDescription:
The **Elite Attack Aircraft** is a high-speed, powerful aircraft designed to effectively eradicating ground units. Researching this unit will give you an edge over landlocked zombie hordes.

[image, missions-mission_37_take_to_the_skies]
13542.shortDescription: Complete the **research** for the *Elite Attack Aircraft*.
13542.title: Take to the Skies!

13543.helpDescription: The Elite Attack Aircraft is devastating against ground units, both against soft and hard targets. It is weak against other air units, and not well-suited against sea units. Use it to quickly destroy ground units, and protect them from enemy airborne units.
13543.longDescription:
The **Elite Attack Aircraft** is one of the most powerful units you can mobilize *against most ground units*. Dominate the skies and gain an invaluable advantage against the Horde, while protecting your borders against possible incursion from other nations.

[image, missions-mission_37_death_from_above]
13543.shortDescription: **Mobilize** an *Elite Attack Aircraft* to vanquish the undead.
13543.title: Death from Above!

13544.helpDescription: Air Superiority Fighter is an excellent unit for taking down any airborne unit, from other aircraft to rotary wing targets or drones. Air Superiority Fighter weapons are not built for ground targets or buildings, they are heavily specialised for airspace control.
13544.longDescription:
The **Air Superiority Fighter** excels against other airborne targets, able to quickly strike at a target or patrol to secure an airspace above a valuable point of interest.

[image, missions-mission_6_research_air_superiority_fighter]
13544.shortDescription: Complete the **research** for the *Air Superiority Fighter* to protect yourself from other nations.
13544.title: Engines On!

13545.helpDescription: Air Superiority Fighter is an excellent unit for taking down any airborne unit, from other aircraft to rotary wing targets or drones. Air Superiority Fighter weapons are not built for ground targets or buildings, they are heavily specialised for airspace control.
13545.longDescription:
The **Air Superiority Fighter** is effective solution against *all air targets*. As other nations build their forces to combat the Undead, think ahead and prepare for the fight against the living as well.

[image, missions-mission_15_mobilize_air_superiority_fighter]
13545.shortDescription: **Mobilize** an *Air Superiority Fighter* to control the skies.
13545.title: Kick the Tires and Light the Fires!

13546.helpDescription: Military Logistics establishes roadworks and other transport systems to expedite movement of all ground units. Be careful as these will be destroyed if the province it is built in is captured by the enemy.
13546.longDescription:
**Military Logistics** offers your troops increased speed, allowing you to *react faster to enemy incursions*. Important to note is that these will be destroyed if the province is conquered.

[image, missions-mission_39_immediate_response]
13546.shortDescription: Speed up travel between two cities by **building** *Military Logistics*.
13546.title: Immediate Response!

13547.helpDescription: Combat Outposts are defensive fortifications that provide your units to use for cover and to entrench outside of cities. Combat Outposts do not offer any benefits to provinces without units, make sure you have units stationed in them, giving you control over a key province.
13547.longDescription:
**Combat Outposts** are a good way to defend your provinces, as they provide a decent *entrenchment bonus to troops stationed there*. Important to note is that these will be destroyed if the province is conquered.

[image, missions-mission_39_fortify_your_borders]
13547.shortDescription: **Build** 2 *Combat Outposts* in provinces of your choosing.
13547.title: Fortify your Borders!

13548.helpDescription: Underground Bunkers can be built in cities to provide improved defense for the stationed units and protects the local populace, maintaining morale. This building is hidden and cannot be seen by other nations.
13548.longDescription:
The best offense is a good defense as **Underground Bunkers** provide significant *entrenchment bonuses*, giving your soldiers increased defense in the city.

[image, missions-mission_39_no_entry]
13548.shortDescription: **Upgrade** *Underground Bunkers* in a strategically important city to level 2.
13548.title: No Entry!

50413.helpDescription: Havens are enormous underground city-like structures that provide shelter to people who managed to hide inside before the zombie outbreak. They provide a great deal of manpower, and you need all you can get to reestablish world order.
50413.longDescription:
**Havens** are invaluable and can turn the tide of war, as they *increase your manpower generation* with people who are immune to the infection. Move into zombie-controlled territory and liberate a Haven to strengthen your resources.

[image, missions-mission_38_reclamation_day]
50413.title: Reclamation Day!

50414.helpDescription:
[step 1, missions-help-mission_55_1, Control Points are spread across the world, protected by the violent environmentalist groups.]
[step 2, missions-help-mission_55_2, Defeat them and protect them as they provide Victory Points daily. You retain Victory Points you earned even if you lose occupation of the Control Point.]
[step 3, missions-help-mission_55_3, You must occupy a Control Point to gain Victory Points at day’s end.]

Make sure your Control Points are protected as other nations will strive to take them over for manpower and for Victory Points respectively. Only by holding Control Points at the end of the day can you maintain your armies, and win the fight for Nuclear Winter: Domination.
50414.longDescription:
With the everlasting nuclear winter, value of land and cities has fallen as nations war over facilities that provide means of survival and to nurture the healthy populations that hide within Vaults and Havens.

**Conquer and hold Control Points**, which are various sites across the world that *provide Victory Points at day end*. Victory Points you have won are yours to keep as *Victory Points are permanent*. Make sure your Control Points are defended well.

**Protect and take over Vaults and Havens** as they are last bastion of humanity, and *provide you with manpower*.

**Quell the Chosen** that are trying to collapse civilization as we know it. Beware of your morale or they might rise up in your cities.

[image, missions-mission_55]
50414.shortDescription: **Read more** about the unique *rules of this scenario*.
50414.title: Survive Nuclear Winter: Domination

50415.helpDescription: Motorized Infantry excel in cities and as the backbone when attacking and conquering, but the Mountain Variant is specially trained for Arctic and Mountain terrains. Great numbers is their strong suit and provide them with support against artillery and air attacks for maximum effect.
50415.longDescription:
**Mountain Infantry** are a variant of Motorized Infantry, specialized units good at fighting in *Tundra* and *Mountain* terrains. They are a flexible unit that excels as a defensive force supported by Bunkers and Combat Outposts. 

[image, missions-mission_40]
50415.shortDescription: **Research** *Motorized Infantry* to unlock the Mountain Variant.
50415.title: Arctic Warfare I

50416.helpDescription: Motorized Infantry excel in cities and as the backbone when attacking and conquering, but the Mountain Variant is specially trained for Arctic and Mountain terrains. Great numbers is their strong suit and provide them with support against artillery and air attacks for maximum effect.
50416.longDescription:
**Mountain Infantry** are a variant of Motorized Infantry, specialized units good at fighting in *Tundra* and *Mountain* terrains. They are a flexible unit that excels as a defensive force supported by Bunkers and Combat Outposts. 

[image, missions-mission_41]
50416.shortDescription: **Mobilize** *Mountain Infantry* and fight for the arctic wasteland.
50416.title: Arctic Warfare II

50417.helpDescription: Mountain Infantry is effective at fighting in Arctic and Mountain terrains, make sure you use them for offense and defense in those terrain types. Providing support units to them to better survive against armored, air and artillery attacks is advised.
50417.longDescription:
*Conquering* strengthens your strategic position and economy, extends your defensive position and giving you valuable extra resources. Only infantry units can accomplish this task. Make sure to utilize your Mountain Infantry in Tundra and Mountain environments as they are specialized units for those terrains.

[image, missions-mission_42]
50417.title: Arctic Warfare III

50418.helpDescription: Guided Missile Program provides you with ability to make Warheads, resource for Cruise and Ballistic Missiles that are devastating against most units. It is a required step to launch Nuclear Missiles. To launch missiles, you must have mobilized the right units such as Cruisers, Heavy Bombers or Submarines that are able to launch missiles.
50418.longDescription:
The **Guided Missile Program** is the first step to *reaching the technology to launch nuclear missiles*. It also provides you with ability to make Warheads, a resource you need to launch Cruise and Ballistic Missiles. Be prepared and mobilize the right units such as Cruisers, Heavy Bombers or Submarines that can launch missiles. 

[image, missions-mission_43]
50418.shortDescription: **Research** *Guided Missile Program* as you prepare for the nuclear option.
50418.title: I Want To Set The World On Fire I

50419.helpDescription: Chemical Weapons Program provides you with ability to make Warheads, resource for Cruise and Ballistic Missiles that cause contamination on impact and are deadly against soft targets. It is a required step to launch Nuclear Missiles. To launch missiles, you must have mobilized the right units such as Cruisers, Heavy Bombers or Submarines that are able to launch missiles.
50419.longDescription:
The **Chemical Weapons Program** is the second step to *reaching the technology to launch nuclear missiles*. It also provides you with ability to make Chemical Warheads, a resource you need to launch Cruise and Ballistic Missiles that cause contamination on impact and are deadly against soft targets. Be prepared and mobilize the right units such as Cruisers, Heavy Bombers or Submarines that can launch missiles. 

[image, missions-mission_44]
50419.shortDescription: **Research** *Chemical Weapons Program* as you prepare to inflict maximum human casualties.
50419.title: I Want To Set The World On Fire II

50420.helpDescription: Nuclear Weapons Program provides you with ability to make Warheads, resource for Nuclear Missiles that vaporize everything in its blast zone. It is a required step to launch Nuclear Missiles. To launch missiles, you must have mobilized the right units such as Cruisers, Heavy Bombers or Submarines that are able to launch missiles.
50420.longDescription:
The **Nuclear Weapons Program** is the third step to *reaching the technology to launch nuclear missiles*. It provides you with ability to make Nuclear Warheads, a resource you need to launch Nuclear Missiles that vaporize everything in its blast zone. Be prepared and mobilize the right units such as Cruisers, Heavy Bombers or Submarines that can launch missiles.

[image, missions-mission_45]
50420.shortDescription: **Research** *Nuclear Weapons Program* as Doomsday Clock gets closer to midnight.
50420.title: I Want To Set The World On Fire III

50421.helpDescription: Nuclear Weapons Program provides you with ability to make Warheads, resource for Nuclear Missiles that vaporize everything in its blast zone. It is a required step to launch Nuclear Missiles. To launch missiles, you must have mobilized the right units such as Cruisers, Heavy Bombers or Submarines that are able to launch missiles.
50421.longDescription:
The **Nuclear ICBM** is the final research step to *reaching the technology to launch nuclear missiles*. It provides you with ability to make Nuclear ICBM missiles, a resource you need to launch Nuclear Missiles that vaporize everything in its blast zone. Be prepared and mobilize the right units such as Cruisers, Heavy Bombers or Submarines that can launch missiles.

[image, missions-mission_46]
50421.shortDescription: **Research** *Nuclear ICBM* as Doomsday Clock gets closer to midnight.
50421.title: I Want To Set The World On Fire IV

50422.helpDescription: Nuclear Missiles vaporize everything in their blast zones. To launch missiles, you must have mobilized the right units such as Cruisers, Heavy Bombers or Submarines that are able to launch missiles. Nuclear Missiles can be destroyed mid-flight by Theater Defense System, beware of firing your nuclear missiles if the enemy is well-protected.
50422.longDescription:
The **Nuclear ICBM** is devastating and destroys *all units it hits*. Be prepared and mobilize the right units such as Cruisers, Heavy Bombers or Submarines that can launch missiles. They are expensive to produce but allow you quickly destroy well-entrenched enemy armies.

[image, missions-mission_47]
50422.shortDescription: **Launch** a *Nuclear ICBM* and vaporize your enemies.
50422.title: I Want To Set The World On Fire V

50423.helpDescription: Frigate provides a balanced approach against most hostile units on the seas, but it excels against Fixed Wing targets, such as Strike Fighters and Bombers. It is best used in a supportive capacity as part of fleets, or as an escort to transport ships.
50423.longDescription:
**Frigate** offers decent combat capabilities *against most naval and aerial units*. It is best used in a supportive capacity as part of fleets, or as an escort to transport ships.

[image, missions-mission_48]
50423.shortDescription: **Research** the *Frigate* that can be upgraded to launch cruise missiles.
50423.title: Icebreaker I

50424.helpDescription: Elite Frigate provides a balanced approach against most hostile units on the seas, and can serve as an impromptu forward operating base to launch attacks on land with helicopters and cruise missiles.
50424.longDescription:
**Elite Frigate** offers decent combat capabilities against most naval units but *excels against aerial units*. Offering versatility as well, it is capable of carrying Helicopters and, if researched, can launch cruise missiles.

[image, missions-mission_49]
50424.shortDescription: **Research** the *Elite Frigate* that can be upgraded to launch cruise missiles.
50424.title: Icebreaker II

50425.helpDescription: Elite Frigate provides a balanced approach against most hostile units on the seas, and can serve as an impromptu forward operating base to launch attacks on land with helicopters and cruise missiles.
50425.longDescription:
**Elite Frigate** offers decent combat capabilities against naval units but *excels against aerial units*. Offering versatility as well, it is capable of carrying Helicopters and, if researched, can launch cruise missiles.

[image, missions-mission_50]
50425.shortDescription: **Mobilize** an *Elite Frigate* to crush the waves and enemies alike.
50425.title: Icebreaker III

50426.helpDescription: Control Points provide Victory Points to the occupier. They are heavily protected at first, and you should defend it well once you conquer one. Not all Control Points provide same amount of Victory Points, read through Introductory Mission on Mobile or check the Wiki for more information.
50426.longDescription:
**Control Points** are various buildings across the world that are *required to triumph against other nations*. Control Points provide Victory Points to the occupier at the end of each day.

[image, missions-mission_51]
50426.shortDescription: **Conquer** a *Control Point* to start working towards victory.
50426.title: Icebreaker IV

50427.helpDescription: Army Base provides you with new units to mobilize with each level. For more advanced units you need higher levels of the Army Base. Protect the cities that have a higher level buildings as those cities will be a higher priority target for your enemies.
50427.longDescription:
**Army Base** is required for mobilization of various units, including Theater Defense System that will help us *defend from missile attacks on our homeland*.

[image, missions-mission_52]
50427.shortDescription: **Build** a Level 5 *Army Base* to be able to produce specialized units. It is also a **pre-requisite** for Theater Defense System.
50427.title: I Don’t Want To Set The World On Fire I

50428.helpDescription: Theater Defense System is an expensive support unit that protects from missile attacks. Protect it from direct combat and position it to protect your cities or use it as an escort for large armies.
50428.longDescription:
Long-range surface-to-air defense system, **Theater Defense System** envelops an area and *protects from all missile attacks*, as well as it deals minimal damage to Fixed Wing targets. It is weak when attacked directly, protecting it with other ground units is advised.

[image, missions-mission_53]
50428.shortDescription: **Research** the *Theater Defense System* and protect your crucial points of interest.
50428.title: I Don’t Want To Set The World On Fire II

50429.helpDescription: Theater Defense System is an expensive support unit that protects from missile attacks. Protect it from direct combat and position it to protect your cities or use it as an escort for large armies.
50429.longDescription:
Long-range surface-to-air defense system, **Theater Defense System** envelops an area and *protects from all missile attacks*, as well as it deals minimal damage to Fixed Wing targets. It is weak when attacked directly, protecting it with other ground units is advised.

[image, missions-mission_54]
50429.shortDescription: **Mobilize** the *Theater Defense System* to complete the anti-missile protection program.
50429.title: I Don’t Want To Set The World On Fire III

50430.helpDescription:
[step 1, missions-help-mission_55_1, Rivers are a new terrain that prevents large naval units to traverse, and that speed up smaller units.] 
[step 2, missions-help-mission_55_2, Marines and Elite AFVs excel in water-to-land traversal.] 
[step 3, missions-help-mission_55_3, Oil Rigs provide you with fuel, a highly-sought resource for upkeep of your armies. Need to be captured by naval or airborne infantry.] 
Build navy to contest Oil Rigs and protect your rivers, and make sure that you utilize naval units where they excel.
50430.longDescription:
As the seas swell, rivers become the crucial means of transport and defense for all nations and oil resurfacing causes mayhem as all powers of the world seek to use them for their machines of war.

**Master the Rivers**, with the swelling of waters, rivers have become important chokepoints that lead into nearly all nations of the world. Build *Naval Base Level 2* to be able to mobilize smaller ships, and to quickly disembark your amphibious units.

**Use your amphibious units**, Navy is a requirement to survive on the open seas, however to brave the rivers you must *rely on your Amphibious units*. Prepare to cross and defend your rivers and use them for quicker and easier travel between nations.

**Conquer and defend your Oil Rigs**, fighting over seas was never as crucial as now, with Oil Rigs becoming the primary source of oil for all nations. To build an army worthy of world domination you must *capture and control Oil Rigs using naval or airborne infantry*.

[image, missions-mission_55]
50430.shortDescription: **Read more** about the unique *rules of this scenario*.
50430.title: Survive Rising Tides 2060

50431.helpTitle: Researching Amphibious Combat Vehicle OR Armored Fighting Vehicle
50431.helpDescription:
Amphibious Combat Vehicle allows assaults to be launched from unpredictable fronts as they do not require a Harbor to embark or disembark to sea. It is an effective armored unit that can defeat most other ground units and, if further improved, can reveal stealth ground units, making it exceptional unit in any army.

Armored Fighting Vehicle is the armored backbone of any army, capable of destroying infantry and holding well against other armored units. If improved, it can be airlifted between airfields.
50431.longDescription:
**Amphibious Combat Vehicle** is a versatile assault unit of *formidable strength against armored and infantry alike*. It excels in the Forest, Jungle and Arctic terrain. It can embark or disembark without the need of a Harbor. If fully upgraded, it can reveal stealth ground units.

**Armored Combat Vehicles** are strong and yet cost-efficient armored unit that is *effective against infantry and decent against other armored units*, but very weak against flying targets. It excels in deserts and tundra, and has decent protection in the cover of forests.

[image, missions-mission_56]
50431.shortDescription: **Research** the *Amphibious Combat Vehicle* OR *Armored Fighting Vehicle* that is required for the Elite Armored Fighting Vehicle.
50431.title: Storm of War I

1.name: Frontline Test Game
1.description: A closed beta or alpha game with new features for Frontline Beta Players.

2.name: Peace Period
2.description: Specifies a minimum time in days at the beginning of a game in which other players can not be attacked.

3.name: NPC Peace Period
3.description: Specifies a minimum time in days at the beginning of a game in which computer controlled countries can not be attacked.

4.name: Honor Period
4.description: Specifies a minimum time between a declaration of war and the first battles.

5.name: Minimum activity period
5.description: Specifies the time after which a player is taken over by the AI and can be replaced by the game admin.

6.name: Anonymous Game
6.description: An anonymous game does not show user names.

7.name: Gold Limitation
7.description: A game with limited gold usage (tournament mode).

8.name: Tournament Game
8.description: A tournament game is part of a tournament referenced by an ID.

9.name: Start Level
9.description: The start level specifies the amount of start resources, techs and units.

12.name: Unit pack
12.description: Specifies which extra units and buildings are available in this game.

15.name: Quest Round
15.description: Quests to conquer provinces will spawn in this game.

3210.name: Reveal Nation's Forces
3210.description: Reveal the targeted nation's armies. Intel gathered at the moment of spy-action execution is visible until day-change.

3213.name: ACCELERATE
3213.description: Accelerates research speed of the current technology by up to 12 hours

22094.name: Helicarrier Mission Reward
22094.description: You have unlocked the ability to research the Helicarrier in all your games.

178.name: Premium Account
178.description:
Players with a Premium Account have access to advanced functionality and usability features:

On all platforms:
  • Build queue for units & buildings
  • Province rally points
  • Shared Intelligence with allies
  • Advanced fire control for units
  • Join matches with Gold features for free
  • Exclusive Premium Account badge
  • More pictures for newspaper articles
  • Recruiting offices for free

Only in Desktop version:
  • Create 1 own match per month (at lvl. 4+)

12372.name: Gather Country Intel
12372.description: Discloses a nation's resources, diplomatic relations, communications, agent positions and unit mobilization.

12374.name: Disrupt Economy
12374.description: Destroys a part of daily local resource production.

3201.name: ACCELERATE
3201.description: Accelerates construction speed of the current building by up to 12 hours

3202.name: ACCELERATE
3202.description: Accelerates mobilization speed of the current unit by up to 12 hours

3203.name: REINFORCE
3203.description: Replenishes the hit points of the selected unit by {amount}%

3204.name: STOCK UP
3204.description: Purchases an amount of the selected resources for gold

3205.name: PREMIUM OFFER
3205.description: Individualized premium offer for the player

3206.name: BOOST MORALE
3206.description: Boosts morale of the selected population by 10%

3207.name: PREMIUM MISSION
3207.description: Hire a specialist for a special mission in this province. The selected mission will be executed immediately.

3208.name: Reveal Local Forces
3208.description: Momentarily reveals any army, owned by any nation, that is located in and around the targeted area at the exact moment the spy action is executed.
